$comment: UI-parity ratchet baseline (introduced by web-app-2.0 Phase 0). check_ui_parity.mjs --strict fails on any FORWARD gap whose capability is NOT listed in `grandfathered` below. These are the pre-existing app-layer capabilities that already have a UI binding but still lack a runtime `proof` (or, for a few, a binding at all) as of the strict-gate turn-on. They are the *content* work of web-app-2.0 Phases 1-6 — each phase that builds/finishes one of these pages MUST add its e2e/screenshot proof (or binding) and REMOVE the capability from this list. This is a one-way ratchet: the list only shrinks, and any NEW app-layer capability shipped without a working, proven page fails --strict immediately. Do NOT add names here to silence a fresh gap.
